LanguageData.ColonyTemplate_WillOverwrite: A template with this name exists and will be replaced.
LanguageData.ColonyTemplate_Problems: The template was applied with some problems:
LanguageData.ColonyTemplate_TooManyPawns: The template has {0} colonists but this scenario has room for {1}; the extra ones were skipped.
LanguageData.ColonyTemplate_SaveColonists: Save current colonists as crew template
LanguageData.ColonyTemplate_AutoApply: Apply colony setup automatically when a new game starts
LanguageData.ColonyTemplate_AutoApplyTip: Runs once on the first tick of a new colony. You can always run it from the "setup" button on the bottom bar.
LanguageData.ColonyTemplate_ScheduleHelp: 24 letters, one per hour from midnight: S sleep, W work, J recreation, M meditate, A anything. Night owls get it shifted 12 hours.
LanguageData.ColonyTemplate_ScheduleInvalid: Needs exactly 24 letters from S W J M A - the schedule is not applied until fixed.
LanguageData.ColonyTemplate_DoPriorities: Set work priorities from skills and passions
LanguageData.ColonyTemplate_DoPrioritiesTip: Turns on manual priorities. The best colonist at each job gets 1, major passion or skill 10+ gets 2, minor passion or skill 6+ gets 3, the rest 4. Firefighting and bed rest 1, basic work 2, hauling and cleaning 3.
LanguageData.ColonyTemplate_DoPolicies: Set medicine, self-tend and hostility response
LanguageData.ColonyTemplate_DoPoliciesTip: Colonists incapable of violence flee, everyone else attacks.
